title: Processing Bulk Calling Card Sequencing Data
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwjfpcn

steps.title: Trim Primer Barcode and Transposon Sequence
steps.instruction: Trim the primer barcode and the piggyBac transposon sequence (ending in TTAA) from the start of read 1. Only reads with perfect matches are carried forward.

steps.title: Trim Nextera Adapters
steps.instruction: Trim Nextera adapters from the ends of the reads to reduce non-genomic bases and accelerate alignment.

substeps.instruction: Run cutadapt: cutadapt -a CTGTCTCTTATACACATCTCCGAGCCCACGAGACT CTCACGGTGA TCTCGTATGCCGTCTTCTGCTTG --minimum-length 1 -o PBase_rep1_trimmed.fastq.gz Base_rep1_trimBC.fastq.gz (Note: replace the index sequence with N's of the same length if processing multiple different indexes)

steps.title: Align Reads to Genome
steps.instruction: Align the trimmed reads to the reference genome (e.g., hg38).

substeps.instruction: Run novoalign: novoalign -d hg38.nvx -f PBase_rep1_trimmed.fastq.gz -n 40 -o SAM -o SoftClip > PBase_rep1_trimmed.sam (The -n 40 flag aligns only the first 40 bases)

steps.title: Filter and Sort Alignment
steps.instruction: Filter out reads that mapped to multiple locations and convert the output to a sorted BAM format.

substeps.instruction: Run samtools: samtools view -bS -h -F 260 PBase_rep1_trimmed.sam | samtools sort - -o PBase_rep1_mapped.bam

steps.title: Annotate BAM with Barcode and Index
steps.instruction: Add custom tags to the BAM file to identify the primer barcode and index sequence.

substeps.instruction: Annotate primer barcode (XP tag): python TagBam.py --tag XP:Z:GAT PBase_rep1_mapped.bam PBase_rep1_tagged.bam
Annotate index sequence (XJ tag): python TagBam.py --tag XJ:Z:CTCACGGTGA PBase_rep1_tagged.bam PBase_rep1_tagged2.bam

steps.title: Annotate Insertion Sites
steps.instruction: Verify that reads map next to the piggyBac insertion site motif (TTAA) and annotate coordinates and adjacent sequences.

substeps.instruction: Run AnnotateInsertionSites.py: python AnnotateInsertionSites.py --transposase PB -f PBase_rep1_tagged2.bam hg38.2bit PBase_rep1_final.bam

steps.title: Index BAM and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Index the final BAM file and remove intermediate files to save space.

substeps.instruction: Delete intermediate files: PBase_rep1_trimBC.fastq.gz, PBase_rep1_trimmed.fastq.gz, PBase_rep1_trimmed.sam, PBase_rep1_mapped.bam, PBase_rep1_tagged.bam, PBase_rep1_tagged2.bam

steps.title: Convert BAM to CCF Format
steps.instruction: Convert the annotated BAM file into a Calling Card Format (.ccf) file using the barcode and index tags.

substeps.instruction: Run BamToCallingCard.py: python BamToCallingCard.py -b XP XJ -i PBase_rep1_final.bam -o PBase_rep1_final.ccf

steps.title: Combine Replicates
steps.instruction: Consolidate data from multiple biological replicates into single experiment files.

substeps.instruction: Combine CCF files using bedops: cat PBase_rep1_final.ccf [etc...] | sort-bed - > PBase.ccf
Alternatively, combine CCF files using bedtools: cat PBase_rep*_final.ccf | bedtools sort -i - > PBase.ccf
Alternatively, combine CCF files using shell sort: cat PBase_rep*_final.ccf | sort -k1V -k2n -k3n > PBase.ccf
Combine BAM files for archival: samtools merge PBase.bam PBase_rep*_final.bam
